# Scenario: Instant Cross-Border Payments

## What you're building

You're a PM at a 50-person fintech startup. You want to write a PRD for a new feature: **instant cross-border payments**. Today, sending money across countries takes 1–3 business days; you want it to happen in under 60 seconds.

## Why now

Your largest competitor launched a similar feature six months ago and is winning customers because of it. Your sales team has been pushing this for a quarter. You finally have engineering capacity to start in Q4.

## What you broadly know

- The biggest customer segment for this is small businesses paying international contractors.
- There are real regulatory constraints — KYC/AML compliance is non-negotiable.
- You'll integrate with at least two payment rails to get coverage; the engineering team has shortlisted candidates but not committed.
- Success will be measured by adoption (% of cross-border payments going through the instant path).

## What you don't know yet

- Specific compliance requirements per corridor — needs legal review.
- Exact rail costs at volume — depends on the partner you sign with.
- Whether to roll out by corridor (US-MX first) or globally on day one.

Stay in character as this PM throughout the session. Invent details consistent with the above when asked.
